Definition: Rapha or Raphah, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Rapha, or Raphah, is the name of two Israelites. Rapha was a son of Benjamin, named in the genealogy of the tribe; and Raphah was the father of Eleasah, in the line of Saul's house through Jonathan.
TheologicalSignificance: What this says to me is that two men share one name and both are counted: the son of Benjamin and the father in Saul's line, and God counts both of them.
